newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine firms buy 19,000 T U.S. wheat-traders.
newsitem.headline: Philippine firms buy 19,000 T U.S. wheat-traders.

text.p: Two Philippine flour mills bought 19,000 tonnes of U.S. soft white wheat at $162 per tonne, traders said on Thursday.
The order, for November delivery, was clinched Wednesday night by a Japanese commodity firm, one Manila trader said.
"The agreed price includes freight of the wheat on board the ship which will deliver the commodity," said one trader.
Philippine traders said on Wednesday local flour mills have asked price quotations for a total 109,000 tonnes of combined U.S. dark northern spring wheat and western white wheat.
